scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.backend:migrate: cd backend && uv run --frozen alembic upgrade head
scripts.backend:migrate:status: cd backend && uv run --frozen alembic current && uv run --frozen alembic heads
scripts.build: python backend/scripts/guard_vercel_build.py && npm --prefix frontend run build
